limitations: Only a small number of independent REPD snapshots are available.
The REPD inclusion threshold changed in 2021.
Entity resolution can be imperfect when stable reference IDs are absent.
Public sources do not reveal private finance, land, equipment or contract terms.
Forecasts are research estimates, not investment advice.

issues.impact: The number of independent time points is too small to estimate macroeconomic effects reliably.
Projects without stable reference IDs are more vulnerable to false matches or split histories.
